label: miso5 firmhydro
definition: (KEEPER structure / NOT-YET metrics) Adds a SEPARATE firm-hydro IMPORT block for Manitoba Hydro (~12.3 TWh/yr = 1,400 MW must-flow firm contracted hydro into MISO-North) — MISO's single largest real import and the structural reason it is a net importer. Firm hydro has no gas x heat-rate analogue, so it is OUTSIDE the gas-margin reference-price seam (PJM/SPP/SERC): a low near-constant offer ($8/MWh, MISO_MANITOBA_FIRM_IMPORT_*) landed directly in MISO-North and floored as must-flow (inject_miso_firm_imports), modeled on the NYISO firm-imports mechanism. Volume from the Manitoba export-contract band, NOT fitted to the residual (#12). Default-ON for MISO (MISO_FIRM_IMPORT_DEFAULT_ISOS); requires --priced-interchange; ERCOT byte-identical. RESULT: net interchange moves toward EIA-930 actual in all 3 yrs (base +0.1/-7.5/+45.0 -> -4.83/-13.31/+39.13 TWh; actual -37.9/-23.1/-19.0) and mean LMP edges DOWN (28.71/25.49/36.78 -> 28.54/25.27/36.40; actual 31.79/30.80/42.85) — both exactly as predicted (cheap firm hydro raises imports while displacing marginal gas). Gap only HALF closes: the +12.3 TWh import is partly re-exported by the seam because MISO's LMP sits ~6/14/13% low (the pre-existing miso2 root cause), so a correctly-priced seam stays export-biased. Per #1 the correct structure stays in; closing C2/C3a needs the MISO price-LEVEL fix, not a deeper Manitoba block.
